caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers set against a plain, light beige background. The piece of furniture is composed of two main sections: an upper portion and a lower portion. The upper section has five drawers arranged vertically, with the topmost row divided into three smaller drawers side by side and the following three rows each containing a single, larger drawer. Each drawer features a pair of brass-colored handles and a keyhole. The lower section consists of a single wide drawer, also with two brass-colored handles and a keyhole. Supporting the lower section are four elegantly curved cabriole legs, and the underside edge of the lower section is decorated with a scalloped design. The wood appears polished with a reddish-brown tone, and the handles are shaped in a classic style, perhaps resembling early American or Colonial furniture.
title: Early American highboy
